mainEntity.name: Why is Answer Engine Optimization important for CPAs right now?

acceptedAnswer.text: The rise of generative AI in search engines means users increasingly receive direct answers to their queries without needing to click through to a website. For CPAs, this shift means that if your firm's expertise isn't optimized for these answer engines, potential clients may never encounter your services. AEO ensures your firm's knowledge is directly surfaced, establishing authority and trustworthiness at the point of inquiry. This early visibility is crucial for capturing new clients who rely on AI for immediate, accurate information regarding financial advice, tax preparation, and auditing needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO is crucial for CPAs now because AI search engines provide direct answers, meaning firms need to optimize to ensure their expertise is visible and establishes authority.
